project: cc-safety-net-wiring assertion (d) asserts the resolved version
description: rev 2, revised against 13 findings from two adversarial critics (see critique.md). Assertion (d) of .oh/evals/probes/cc-safety-net-wiring.sh matches the declared dependency range in the boot-generated .pi/npm/package.json, which npm writes as a caret range, so the tier-A probe reports REGRESSION while every oracle agrees the pin is 1.0.6. Replace the range match with a resolved-version check read from .pi/npm/package-lock.json and .pi/npm/node_modules/cc-safety-net/package.json, keep the absent-runtime-state posture, close the override disarm hole, and verify the assertion by rejection with a mutation check.

userStories.title: Assertion (d) reads the resolved version
userStories.description: As a harness maintainer, I want assertion (d) to compare the resolved cc-safety-net version against the pin, so that the probe reports drift that is real and stays silent when there is none.
acceptanceCriteria: Assertion (d) reads the resolved version from .pi/npm/package-lock.json (.packages["node_modules/cc-safety-net"].version, falling back to .dependencies["cc-safety-net"].version) and from .pi/npm/node_modules/cc-safety-net/package.json (.version)
The old range match is gone: git diff shows the grep -Eq range line removed, and no assertion compares the declared range against the pin
Every resolved source that exists is checked, and a mismatch in either source fails the probe with its own line
Each (d) failure line names the file, the version found, the pin, and one remediation clause
Rules R1 through R7 in prd.md are implemented as written
The JSON interpreter is invoked only when a source file exists; the probe never exits 2 for a missing interpreter, and never aborts under set -euo pipefail on unparseable JSON
The assertion-(d) comment describes resolved-version semantics rather than the removed range match
bash -n .oh/evals/probes/cc-safety-net-wiring.sh exits 0
git diff shows no textual change to assertions (a), (b), (c), (e), (f) or to the live-binary block
Behavioral proof that (a) through (f) are unchanged: with node removed from PATH and .claude/settings.json deliberately broken in a scratch copy, the probe still exits 1 and still names (a)
userStories.notes: Validated by the First Mate, not self-certified. git diff inspected hunk by hunk: only line 23 (PI_PKG -> PI_NPM) and the (d) region changed; (a),(b),(c),(e),(f) and the live-binary block are byte-identical. R1-R7 live at lines 93-130. AC 10 was reassigned to US-003 and met there: with node stripped from PATH a correct .claude/settings.json produced no (a) line and a broken one still exited 1 naming (a).

userStories.title: Before and after on the default path
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want one controlled comparison over identical input, so that I can tell a real fix from a probe that was already green.
acceptanceCriteria: A throwaway fixture is materialized at the worktree's own gitignored .pi/npm/, carrying package.json declaring "cc-safety-net": "^1.0.6", package-lock.json resolving 1.0.6, and node_modules/cc-safety-net/package.json at 1.0.6
With CC_SAFETY_NET_PROBE_PI_NPM unset, the probe at HEAD (git show HEAD:.oh/evals/probes/cc-safety-net-wiring.sh) run against that fixture exits 1 and names (d)
With CC_SAFETY_NET_PROBE_PI_NPM unset, the fixed probe run against the same fixture exits 0 and prints its PASS line
With the override unset and the fixture's resolved version changed to a version other than 1.0.6, the fixed probe exits 1, proving the default path reads $ROOT/.pi/npm rather than only the override
The fixture is removed afterwards and git status --porcelain is clean of it
With no .pi/npm/ present, the fixed probe exits 0 and assertion (d) contributes no failure line
Read-only cross-check: pointed by the override at the real tree /home/sandbox/harness/.pi/npm, the fixed probe exits 0
sha256sum of the three real files under /home/sandbox/harness/.pi/npm/ is recorded before and after all verification runs and is identical
Both raw outputs from criteria 2 and 3 are captured verbatim for evidence.md
userStories.notes: Validated by the First Mate, who re-ran the before/after personally rather than accepting the delegate's transcript. Identical fixture, override unset, default path: HEAD's probe rc=1 naming (d); the fixed probe rc=0. Drifting the fixture to 1.0.9 with the override still unset gave rc=1, which is what rules out a fix that only works through the override. Fixture removed; git status clean; the live .pi/npm checksums are unchanged.

userStories.title: Verification by rejection
userStories.description: As a harness maintainer, I want proof that assertion (d) rejects, so that its green state is evidence rather than decoration.
acceptanceCriteria: Every rejection run keeps ROOT at the real repo and varies only CC_SAFETY_NET_PROBE_PI_NPM, so unrelated assertions cannot supply the exit code

Pointed at a tree whose resolved version is not 1.0.6, the probe exits 1, every failure line begins with (d), and for a single-source drifted tree stderr carries exactly one failure line naming the file and the version found (a both-sources-drifted tree emits two lines by design, per DD-2)
A lock-only tree and an installed-package-only tree each fail on their own
A tree whose declared range is exactly 1.0.6 but whose resolved version is not still fails
A tree that declares cc-safety-net but resolves nothing fails (R5)
CC_SAFETY_NET_PROBE_PI_NPM set to a path that does not exist fails (R1)
CC_SAFETY_NET_PROBE_PI_NPM set to an existing empty directory fails (R6), so the override cannot disarm the assertion
Mutation check: with assertion (d) stripped from a scratch copy of the probe, the drifted tree from criterion 2 exits 0, proving the exit code came from assertion (d) and nothing else
Every rejection run uses a temporary tree under the scratchpad, and the real .pi/npm/ tree keeps the checksums recorded in US-002
userStories.notes: Eleven cases, all as expected. The First Mate re-ran the mutation check independently and on the DEFAULT path (the delegate ran it through the override): with lines 48-131 stripped, the same drifted tree exits 0 where the real probe exits 1, so the exit code is attributable to assertion (d) alone. Positive control included so the rejections cannot be passing for the wrong reason.

userStories.title: Scoreboard, changelog, tracked artifacts
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want the suite scoreboard and the changelog to record this fix, so that the change is auditable from the diff alone.
acceptanceCriteria: bash .oh/skills/eval/run.sh completes and .oh/evals/RESULTS.md shows cc-safety-net-wiring with status PASS, recorded as bookkeeping because the row was SKIPPED and would have flipped without this fix
A pre-change and a post-change run of the same 99-probe suite are compared, and no probe moves PASS to REGRESSION
CHANGELOG.md gains one bullet under [Unreleased] / Fixed that cites issue #759

evidence.md follows .oh/skills/audit/references/reviewer-evidence-doc.md: audit run id, verbatim native verdict, each of the six issue acceptance criteria mapped to observed proof, the US-002 before and after outputs quoted verbatim, and a gaps section stating that the SKIPPED to PASS row is not evidence of the fix
.oh/tasks/ccsn-probe-resolved-version/ holds prd.md, prd.json, critique.md, progress.txt and evidence.md, and git ls-files reports all five as tracked
